hints.en: The field is written `balance: i64`, with no `pub`.

tests.code: let mut a = bank::Account::new(); assert_eq!(a.deposit(5), Ok(())); assert_eq!(a.deposit(7), Ok(())); assert_eq!(a.balance(), 12);

let mut a = bank::Account::new(); assert_eq!(a.deposit(0), Err(String::from("amount must be positive"))); assert_eq!(a.deposit(-3), Err(String::from("amount must be positive"))); assert_eq!(a.balance(), 0);
